high_level_description: This image is a collage of two photographs taken at an indoor basketball court. Top Photograph: The setting appears to be a basketball arena with rows of red seats in the background. Two women are standing close together, smiling for the camera. The woman on the left is wearing a black Under Armour tracksuit. The woman on the right is dressed in a black blazer over a patterned top, holding a basketball that has been signed and includes a message written on it. The mood is cheerful and celebratory. Bottom Photograph: This photo shows a larger group of people, including a basketball
